tree.label: Backyard, container or community tree

required_parameters.projected_canopy_m2: Scenario/species crown-area range at the selected maturity horizon; alternatively provide initial canopy and annual crown-growth ranges.
required_parameters.initial_canopy_m2: Optional starting crown-area range when annual growth is used.
required_parameters.annual_crown_growth_m2_per_year: Optional source-supported annual crown-growth range used with initial canopy and horizon.
required_parameters.survival_probability: Scenario range from 0 to 1; no universal project default.
required_parameters.site_suitability_factor: Scenario range from 0 to 1; reflects space, soil and water constraints.
required_parameters.overlap_factor: Scenario range from 0 to 1; prevents double-counting overlapping crowns.
required_parameters.site_area_m2: Positive land-unit area used only to cap the literature-bounded cooling envelope.

temperature_evidence_bound.scope: daytime land unit during comparable hot-weather conditions
temperature_evidence_bound.interpretation: Observed association and upper envelope, not a causal per-tree coefficient.

supporting_growth_evidence.interpretation: Local plausibility check only; species-specific projected crown inputs remain required.

tree.calculation_assumption: The evidence upper bound is scaled linearly by the maximum effective-canopy share of the selected land unit and capped at the published maximum. This assumption is transparent but is not a causal estimate.

potted_plants.label: Potted plants

required_parameters.foliage_area_per_pot_m2: Measured or supplier-supported foliage-area range per pot.

potted_plants.calculation_assumption: Only foliage/greenery area is calculated. No outdoor Melbourne temperature effect is assigned without fit-for-purpose primary evidence.

garden_bed.label: Garden bed or low vegetation

temperature_evidence_bound.scope: daytime land unit during comparable hot-weather conditions
temperature_evidence_bound.interpretation: Conservative combined-vegetation envelope; the study found grass weaker than tree canopy and did not provide a causal garden-bed coefficient.

excluded_maximum.reason: Direct experimental plot maximum is not transferable to parcel-average Landsat output.

garden_bed.calculation_assumption: The conservative land-unit upper bound is scaled linearly by maximum established garden-bed share and capped at the evidence maximum.

green_wall.label: Green wall

required_parameters.target_wall_area_m2: Positive wall area used for the coverage calculation.

temperature_evidence_bound.scope: exterior wall during comparable hot summer conditions
temperature_evidence_bound.interpretation: Maximum exterior-wall effect; the study detected no street-canyon air cooling.

green_wall.calculation_assumption: The wall-surface upper bound is scaled linearly by maximum established wall coverage and capped at the evidence maximum. It is never returned as property or neighbourhood LST.
